verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents first-party self-hosting via Docker, Kubernetes/Helm, and OpenShift, which runs the complete platform in your own infrastructure with "full control over your data." That lets you place data wherever you choose. However, nothing in the evidence shows a region or residency choice (e.g., EU vs US) for the managed SaaS, so residency control requires running the platform yourself. Missing for 10: hosted-SaaS region selection, documented data-residency guarantees, independent corroboration.
